newsitem.title: USA: U.S. BULK MILLFEEDS - PRICES CONTINUE STEADY.
newsitem.headline: U.S. BULK MILLFEEDS - PRICES CONTINUE STEADY.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices remained mostly steady on Friday, capping a week of featureless activity as dealers awaited the August 12 U.S. Department of Agriculture crop report and weather conditions for the Midwest this weekend.
"This is a key weekend. There is talk of rain coming through the Midwest this weekend," a dealer said.
Two storm systems will bring chances for rain to the U.S. Midwest this weekend but Weather Services Corp meteorologist Joel Burgio said amounts would likely remain under one inch.
In the southeast, activity was slow but steady.
"I think what is holding up this market is that the mills are making less midds. They might be making the same flour but less midds, about 25 percent less midds," a North Carolina dealer said.
"Everybody has something bought. We are in the middle of contracts, so it is hard to sell more," he added.
